sources.title: GitHub - sangaprabhav/GRPO-adapter
sources.snippet: GRPO Test-Time Adaptation This repository contains an implementation of the GRPO-inspired approach to test-time adaptation for vision models. The system adapts pre-trained models to corrupted test data without requiring access to the original training data or labels.
